explication: Stable-Baselines3 is a PyTorch reinforcement-learning library. A user selects an algorithm and policy, connects an environment, trains through repeated environment interaction and learning updates, then uses the trained model to predict actions. On-policy algorithms collect rollouts; off-policy algorithms store transitions and learn from replay. Shared policies, vectorized environments, buffers, callbacks, logging, and evaluation support these paths. The README documents custom environments and policies, Dict observations, callbacks, and TensorBoard support; the sampled source confirms selected policy, buffer, and vector-environment details, so uncertain internal wiring is omitted.
